'''Doyle''' (Japanese: '''アラタ''' ''Arata'') is a [[Pokémon Trainer]] and a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW035|Where Did You Go, Audino?]]''. 

Doyle was determined to find out what was causing {{p|Audino}} to disappear from the village after his grandfather's had vanished. He and [[Christie]] would often argue about who would discover the missing Audino first and would compete with one another using their {{t|Psychic}} Pokémon. He had a hunch that [[Team Rocket trio|an evil organization]] was taking control of the Audino.

Later on, Doyle was partnered up with {{Ash}} to watch after an elderly couple's Audino, on which they put a tracking device. The Audino soon started acting strange and they followed it and met up with [[Officer Jenny]], {{an|Cilan}}, Christie, and {{an|Iris}}. Doyle managed to slow one of them down with Solosis's {{m|Psychic}}.

Doyle and the others soon found all of the missing Audino and found out that they were being lured by sound waves that Team Rocket had created. He used Solosis to battle both [[Jessie's Woobat]] and [[James's Yamask]]. After the case was solved, Doyle was eager to know if Solosis had helped out more than Christie's {{p|Gothita}}. However, Officer Jenny informed both of them that [[Ash's Roggenrola]] helped out the most, leaving them both disappointed.
